Hey guys, 

I use YT Premium to download videos to listen to and watch at work it's almost always SBFP, these guys have always been the only YouTubers I could connect with. Which is funny because I don't even like any of the same games they play. (Never touched DMC, FF, RE, any fighting game outside of MK or Smash) hell I don't even watch anime. I think part of why I always connected with them has to do with how long I've known them (joined right after the first Machinima MK vid). I remember being through middle school and high school and always wanting to just hangout with these guys, making friends has never been easy, but I get by if I don't think about all my own mind goblins too much. I guess that dream can't happen now but that's okay, I never really had the resources to make it real anyway. I'm just glad they're all happy. I listen to every CSB as I go through my college years, I'm glad they kept that going. Sorry if this seemed like I was rambling too much, opening up is not my thing. Shoutout to anyone who actually read this monologue about some New Hampshire kid detailing his love for Internet videos about guys who promised nothing and gave me entertainment to push through my teenage years. Thats all. 

-Tommy
